title: Namespaces organise a cluster
summary: A namespace groups namespaced resources. It helps separate teams or practice work, but is not by itself a complete security boundary.
introduction: A namespace groups namespaced resources. It helps separate teams or practice work, but is not by itself a complete security boundary. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The names can coexist with similar resources in another namespace. Access controls still matter.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Delete only a namespace you created for disposable practice; it may contain many resources.
